newsitem.title: USA: Oklahoma G&E seeks regional deregulation.
newsitem.headline: Oklahoma G&E seeks regional deregulation.

text.p: Oklahoma Gas and Electric Co believes a regional approach to electric utility industry restructuring is needed, chief executive Steve Moore said Monday.
For the industry to be restructured successfully, he said in a brief statement attached to the company's third quarter earnings report, "five key issues must be addressed."
Deregulation must occur at the same time as in surrounding states and under the same conditions.
A level playing field must be established for all competitors.
The role of regulators must be restructured to manage the competitive environment.
And, no electricity provider should be exempt from the new rules. -- Jim Brumm 212-859-1710.
